args.body: Resolve the existing catalogue item 4 pilot using the committed exact draft and direct live catalogue readback. Reuse any operator decision or completed comparison. If the draft is supported by the live release and its pre-send conditions are met, retain one copy-ready operator send-or-decline handoff. If the draft depends on the commissioned-review candidate, identify the exact unsupported claim and test whether correcting just that claim against the verified live offer preserves the buyer-specific value and existing authorization. If so, save a clearly marked replacement draft for operator review without sending it. Otherwise resume when the candidate is independently approved and verified live. Keep external send, eligible reply, order acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.

description: Treasury verifies CAD 0 available and CAD 0 in revenue. Feedback is available, with no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
